subject.title: Model configuration accepts unvalidated model names, enabling silent misconfiguration

question: Should unknown configured model refs be warning-only in doctor/config validate, hard validation errors, or runtime/startup warnings when catalog authority is incomplete?
rationale: The code can enumerate configured refs, but choosing how to treat unknown refs affects custom providers, forward-compatible model names, fail-closed config validation, and upgrade safety.

options.title: Warning-first validation
options.body: Add catalog-backed doctor/config warnings for unknown configured refs, with wording that distinguishes trusted catalog misses from custom or forward-compatible setups.

options.title: Strict validation
options.body: Reject unknown configured refs at validation time, accepting a compatibility break unless maintainers also define an explicit escape contract.

options.title: Runtime-only diagnostics
options.body: Keep config validation permissive and rely on startup warmup, runtime errors, and fallback notices rather than adding a new config/doctor analyzer.

recommendation.title: Warning-first validation
recommendation.body: Add catalog-backed doctor/config warnings for unknown configured refs, with wording that distinguishes trusted catalog misses from custom or forward-compatible setups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the relevant model-selection, allowlist, config validation, and doctor surfaces.
